PLATELET AGITATOR WITH INCUBATOR Technical Specification Sheet Sl. No. Parameter Technical Specification 1 Purpose Continuously agitate platelet concentrates inside a tem perature-controlled incubator. 2 Basic Design & Refrige Flat-bed agitator fitted inside a temperature-controlled rant incubator operating with CFC-free (source text: 'CIF fre e') refrigerant gas.

3 Incubator Storage & C Platelet Incubator should have the provision to store th ontrols e agitator. a) Platelet Incubator should have a digital temperature indicator. b) Platelet Incubator should have a single digital tempe rature sensor for both recording and controlling. c) Platelet Incubator should have forced air circulation method for uniformity of temperature at all sides of the incubator. 4 Temperature Range Should be able to maintain a temperature of 22°C ± 2° C (Set temperature: 22°C). 5 Construction & Finish External: Sturdy stainless steel / powder-coated finish. Internal Surface: Sturdy and corrosion-resistant. 6 Capacity Designed to hold random platelet packs, apheresis plat elet packs, or a mixture of both types as per user requirement (24 / 48 / 72 / 96 bags). 7 Software & Connectivit Software and/or standard of communication (wherever y required) should be built-in. 8 Noise Level Noise factor should not exceed 60 decibels (dB). 9 Power Requirements Input voltage: 220/240V, 50Hz. 10 Product Certifications CE Class IIA or US FDA certified. 11 Quality Certifications ISO certified. 12 Safety Features • Audio alarm for temperature fluctuation • Auto-stop for agitation when the door is open • Power failure alarm • Push-button switch with pause function for temporary stoppage of motion 13 Technical Evaluation Demonstration of equipment is mandatory for final tech nical approval. 14 Thermograph Integrated thermograph with Inkless/Inkjet (source text: 'Inkjess') technology. 15 Data Storage Integrated data storage facility. 16 Mobility / Mounting Floor-standing model with castor wheels. . 11.
